## Changes

- **Tags that only repeat a name are taken off.** A tag that is the folder's own name, or a performer's name, comes off your folders and scenes, and out of the tag list. Where it named a performer who wasn't on that folder or scene yet, they're added to it instead, so nothing is lost. This happens once, and your catalogue is copied to index-before-tag-names.db.gz first.
